name: Sun Shangxiang
title: The Lady with Bow and Arrows

skills.name: Marriage
skills.text: During your action phase, you can discard two on-hand cards and choose another player (with combined characters as a male) that is not at full-health. That player and you regain 1 unit of health each. Limited to once per phase.

skills.name: Warrior Lady
skills.text: Every instance you lose equipment cards in your equipped item area, you can draw two cards.

differenceFromNormal: The description of "Marriage" has been changed. You cannot marry yourself even if you have a male character card as your major character card. “Warrior Lady” has been weakened. The ability description has been changed from “Whenever you lose an equipment card” to “Every instance you lose equipment cards”. That means Sun Shangxiang can only draw two cards when multiple equipped equipments are discarded, e.g. discarding two equipped equipments to activate the ability of ROCK CLEAVING AXE 贯石斧.
